# Agentic Architect · Sophia Stein
# https://llmstxt.org

> Practical AI workflows, brand systems, and private infrastructure for founders, operators, and modern organizations. Based in Boulder, Colorado.

Sophia Stein is an AI Systems Architect, Educator, and Advisor. Her background spans a B.S. in Computer Science from Columbia University, enterprise strategy and healthcare AI enablement at McKinsey & Company, and AI Systems & Enablement at Google (where she has led extensive internal AI trainings and co-invented a patent-pending AI system; all writing, teaching, and advising on this site are strictly in her personal capacity, views her own). She has trained 300+ founders and operators live at Boulder Startup Week and spoken for Women Who Code.

## Core Focus Areas

1. Small Business & Team AI Enablement: Portable Brand Brain files (`voice.md` + `icp.md`), 90-minute task readiness audits, and human-in-the-loop operational workflows using zero-bloat tools.
2. Cost Governance & Sovereign AI Infrastructure: Practical model routing, data privacy compliance, and encrypted private AI setups you own.
3. Corporate Workshops, Keynotes & University Teaching: Hands-on executive workshops, conference keynotes, and applied university syllabi in Boulder, Denver, and nationwide.
